title: Mass Made Simple by Dan John
author: RdrewS
desc:
A template/worksheet for recording MMS sessions. For trainees weighing 135-185 lbs. For other weight classes, diet and a multitude of other pertinent information, I strongly encourage the trainee to buy Dan John’s book here: 

https://www.otpbooks.com/product/weight-gain-program-mass-made-simple-by-dan-john/

5 sets of 5, ascending weights.

With the top "comfortable" weight, perform an additional set of five.
